verdict.rationale: Smooth's docs say every session gives a `live_url` for watching agent actions in real time. The CLI live-view page adds that you can "take over and interact with the browser yourself," which covers both watching and human takeover. missing for 10: documentation of the handoff mechanics (pausing the agent mid-run and handing control back so it resumes), and independent or hands-on corroboration that takeover works during a stuck run.
